name: ELSTER / German Tax
description: Generate ELSTER-ready USt-Voranmeldung (XML) and EUER (Excel) files, and optionally submit USt-VA to the Finanzamt via ERiC using your own ELSTER certificate.

steuernummer.title: Steuernummer
steuernummer.description: Your tax number as issued by the Finanzamt (Steuernummer).

finanzamt.title: Finanzamt
finanzamt.description: Identifier of the responsible Finanzamt (Bundesfinanzamtsnummer / BUFA-Nr).

certificate.title: ELSTER Certificate
certificate.description: Your ELSTER certificate file (.pfx / .p12). Stored encrypted; used only host-side for ERiC submission, never exposed to the plugin sandbox.

certificatePin.title: Certificate PIN
certificatePin.description: PIN protecting the ELSTER certificate. Stored encrypted; used only host-side for ERiC submission.

exports.name: USt-Voranmeldung (ELSTER)
exports.description: Build an ELSTER-ready USt-VA XML for a single reporting period. Use "Validate only" to check the figures against ERiC without producing a download.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

exports.name: EUER (Excel)
exports.description: Aggregate a full tax year into the Anlage EUER line set and produce an Excel workbook with summary lines and traceable transaction detail.

actions.name: Preview USt-VA figures
actions.description: Compute the USt-VA Kennzahlen for a period and return them as JSON for review. Read-only; AI-callable.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

actions.name: Get filing status
actions.description: Return the recorded filing history / status for this installation. Read-only; AI-callable.

actions.name: Submit USt-VA to Finanzamt
actions.description: Rebuild, validate, and submit the USt-VA to the Finanzamt via ERiC. Irreversible. Requires an explicit UI confirmation token. NOT callable by the AI.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

confirmToken.title: Confirmation Token
confirmToken.description: One-time token minted by the UI confirmation step. Required to authorize the irreversible submission.

testMode.title: Test Mode
testMode.description: When true, submit against the ERiC test Finanzamt (Testmerker) instead of production.
